tests: Date and Unix milliseconds close physical and recovering connections
invalid deadline values do not change state or cancellation ownership
expired deadline fails before sending the close handshake
silent peer hits the absolute deadline and settles channels and notifications
deadline can exceed ordinary connection timeout while waiting for close-ok
null disables only the close deadline and a delayed response can succeed
Date is snapshotted and caller mutation cannot shorten an in-flight deadline
far-future deadlines avoid the Node timer overflow and clear on success
deadline close flushes sent publication bytes without waiting for unreceived confirms
deadline interrupts stalled streamed publication and closes its owned source
closing a partially received stream rejects its completion and frees the connection
generic Duplex backpressure is bounded and drain listeners are removed
successful close-ok disposes an owned Duplex even when its final callback stalls
a second deadline call cannot reset the first close and ordinary close shares it
already exhausted recovery is explicitly disabled even though CloseDeadline rejects
deadline close cancels reconnect and destroys a late transport without resurrection
peer EOF during close propagates failure and leaves a single terminal state
scope: Absolute close deadline, null clearing, deadline input snapshots, no confirm wait, pending streams, arbitrary Duplex backpressure, shared close and terminal recovery ownership. Timing samples only, not production performance.
